info.name: Smart E-Commerce - Stress Testing
info.description: Collection for stress testing optimized endpoints with token caching

request.description: Login to get JWT token. Token is automatically saved to collection variable.

**Endpoint**: GET /api/products
**Purpose**: Read-heavy operation with caching
**Expected Performance**: <5ms (cached), <50ms (uncached)
**Cache Hit Rate**: 85-95%

**Test Scenarios**:
- Vary page numbers (0-10)
- Change size (10, 20, 50)
- Different sort orders (createdAt, name, price)

**Endpoint**: GET /api/orders/{id}
**Purpose**: Single entity retrieval with caching
**Expected Performance**: <2ms (cached), <30ms (uncached)
**Cache Hit Rate**: 90-95%

**Test Scenarios**:
- Use same order_id repeatedly (high cache hit)
- Rotate between 5-10 different order IDs
- Mix with order creation to test cache eviction

**Sample Order IDs**:
- 750e8400-e29b-41d4-a716-446655440003
- 750e8400-e29b-41d4-a716-446655440004
- 750e8400-e29b-41d4-a716-446655440005

**Endpoint**: GET /api/users
**Purpose**: Admin-only query with role-based access
**Expected Performance**: <10ms (cached), <80ms (uncached)
**Cache Hit Rate**: 80-90%
**Requires**: ADMIN role

**Test Scenarios**:
- Different page numbers
- Various page sizes (10, 20, 50, 100)
- Sort by different fields (createdAt, emailAddress, lastName)
- Filter by role (if supported)

**Note**: Requires admin JWT token. Use admin credentials in login.

**Endpoint**: GET /api/products/active
**Purpose**: Filtered product list (active only)
**Expected Performance**: <5ms (cached)
**Cache Hit Rate**: 90-95%

**Endpoint**: GET /api/products/{id}
**Purpose**: Single product retrieval
**Expected Performance**: <2ms (cached)
**Cache Hit Rate**: 95%+
